title: Overview
text:
The following website contains an assortment of curated documents from the radio station McCool FM and the mercenary group PUML.
Note the following symbols denote footnotes which are at the bottom of the page: *, ⁂, ◉, ♢, Δ, and then the greek alphabet starting with α and ending with ω.

title: PuMP: VEILED NIGHTJAR
text:
BACKGROUND  A medical doctor whose mentor was Dr. Moira Finn. They were both known to go above and beyond for their patients. Eventually Dr. Finn died of a heart attack, stroke, and infection caused by a bad tooth she should have seen the dentist about. NIGHTJAR was present and tried but failed to save her. Dr. Finn’s other mentees used this as an opportunity to put the blame on NIGHTJAR. Subsequently, she lost her medical license due to “misconduct”. Not able to help others through medicine, she decided to do so as a mercenary with PUML.
PHYSICAL FEATURES  Monochrome medic: She’s the dictionary definition of a goth doctor. Short perfectly manicured black nails and a black band t-shirt of “Not our dames”. Her smoky eye makeup is impeccable. Yet it could never be dark enough to cover her periorbital hyperpigmentation*.
PERSONALITY QUIRKS  Adaptable but disconnected: Due to her experience as a doctor in ER she can lead a team, create a plan, and quickly pivot when the circumstances change. Unfortunately she also speaks like a doctor, frequently confusing enemies and team mates alike.  Meticulous yet blunt: If given time she likes to prepare with an extreme level of methodical research and planning. However, when she’s in the action she loves to start blasting and smashing.
FAVOURED GEAR

Medical kit
Baseball bat
Walther P88 semiautomatic pistol

PRIMAL STATS  JAWS:0 | EYES:0 | LIMBS:+2 | NERVES:+1
PRIMAL ABILITIES  Yoink: She can teleport items into her hands. The three stipulations are:

The item must fit on her palm
She must be able to directly see or touch the item⁂
This skill has a refractory period of a few minutes

Perfect landing: She can seemingly land on her feet, with no injury, from any height. With this skill and her general acrobatics she is a master at traversing over and around obstacles.
*Dark circles under the eyes generally caused by fatigue  ⁂Having a concealed weapon that she can directly teleport into her hand is handy

title: The Primeval Deities and you: ep2 Nyxmera
text:
Hello listener and welcome to the second episode of The Primeval Deities and you. I am Dr. Harmon Atriti, Professor of Primeval studies at The University of Cambridge, and your vigilant host. In this series we are exploring the four Primeval deities and their influence on our world. In this episode we will investigate Nyxmera, the deity of the skies.
Who is Nyxmera?  Nyxmera is the light. All the celestial bodies are known as the eyes of Nyxmera, the sun, the grey moon, the purple moon, and the stars. With these Nyxmera watches, it wants to be intrigued. Something its followers, Suns of Nyxmera, are more than happy to facilitate.  Nyxmera is everything but rock, water, and life. It craves what it can’t take. There is so much of interest on our tiny orb of dirt, so Nyxmera is stuck in a perpetual gaze on our planet.
What is the icon of Nyxmera? Nyxmera’s symbol is a circle split in two. On the left is a blue background with a yellow circle, the sun and the day sky. On the right is a black background with one grey and one smaller purple circle, the moons and the night sky. This symbolises Nyxmera’s eyes but also its duality. It loves and demands extremes; good and evil, comedy and drama, love and war. It is like a king and we its jesters.
What are the tenants of Nyxmera? Four deities, each with four tenants. Nyxmera’s are:  Observe and sow intrigue.  Balance via duality.  Manipulate and use others.  Eternal beauty over transience.
Who follows Nyxmera? The admirer’s of Nyxmera are called Suns of Nyxmera. They are the entertainers and the entertained. The artists and the aristocrats. They are those who create beauty and those who are bestowed beauty.  Though we humans primarily consider entertainment as arts and sports, to Nyxmera this also includes science. Suns of Nyxmera take an interest in physics, especially related to space. After all, what is Nyxmera but the duality of particles and waves, that is to say light. One of the most exciting periods of the current primeval era was the space age. The USA, ERA, and SAE started the race to reach the grey moon. But once the Japanese refugees claimed their desire to make it their home the whole world banded together to grant their wish. Now we have two nations that follow Nyxmera, the SAE, Supreme Asian Empire, and the Moon. The SAE is the largest nation by population, a blessing and a curse. It is led by China and India, two countries who never agree but always compromise. Despite this they are now the quickest growing super power set to dethrone the USA. Some say this bickering and progress is caused by the variety of cultures across and even within the many countries. Either way I do enjoy good martial arts and Bollywood films. On the other side not much is known about the Moon, the distance allowing them to easily isolate. We know they live in 2 major cities, Kaguya and Usagi, and that they specialise in combustion light-gas guns, hydrogen batteries, and mecha. With these three technologies they plan to retake Japan from the Kaiju. We will learn more about these and other nations in future episodes.
How is Nyxmera’s presence felt?  As with all the deities Nyxmera’s will shapes our existence for its own pleasure. It pushed Tartarus deep into the earth, transforming the surface from inhospitable lava to rock. This allowed Proteus and then Gaia to take hold and so provide Nyxmera the variety it craves. Of course Nyxmera can tire and grow bored with the machinations of life.  And so as we transition to our next topic as Nyxmera can transition the status quo of Earth. It carries out these resets with immense violence through asteroids and meteorites. The destruction of Hitler’s bunker. The extinction of the dinosaurs. The creation of our moons. These impacts and many more were caused by brought down by Nyxmera. Meteorites and their craters are the relics and shrines for the Suns of Nyxmera. 
What are the avatars of Nyxemra?  Though there are many other ways we feel its presence the most obvious and perhaps strangest is through its Starvatars. A crude portmanteau of star and avatar they are the light of a star given physical form. When a Starvatar exists the light of its star can no longer be seen in the night sky. Instead the light now exists as a hard light entity, taking the name of its star or constellation.  Starvatars are humanoid like beings made of the night sky. Their bodies are pitch black with twinkling lights. They have limbs that taper down to points like the human depiction of a star on paper. Invisible digits allow them to handle anything a human could.  All Starvatars of Nyxmera look nearly identical except for their heads. Many of these are animal heads such as a Lion, Bull, or Scorpion for the Leo, Taurus, and Scorpio constellations. Other stranger examples include a Leg, an Arrow, and a seven pointed star for the Andromeda/Kui and Indus constellations, and the Peiades star cluster. On each of their heads is one bright light, their star’s light. This is their eye and with it Nyxmera watches too.
That is a quick introduction to Nyxmera and its infinity of eyes. I am eternally grateful for you lending your ears. Though we covered much on Nyxmera there is always so much more to discover. On the next episode we will chew on the existence of the furious and justified Tartarus. I look forward to speaking with your then dear listener.
crumbs: The Primeval Deities and you: ep2 Nyxmera

title: McCool People: Sol
text:
McCool FM - Interview Transcript  Maggie McCool-Sol, 21st January 1990, 11.00 a.m.
Maggie McCool: You’re listening to McCool FM and I’m your host Maggie McCool. Today we have a very special guest, Sol, the sole survivor of the Laser-US space station. A devout Sun of Nyxmera, they are now touring their new book “Sol the Ablated”. Welcome Sol.
Sol: Happy to be here Maggie McCool.
MM: Why the “Ablated” Sol?
S: Ablation is the process by which parts of an object are removed by destruction. As a meteoroid falls through to our planet it is destroyed layer by layer via friction with the atmosphere. This is why meteorites can be cool when they first land, as the hot surface has vaporised. When I fell down to earth from the station I became ablated. All my physical features were worn away leaving plain, like a mannequin. Some would say I was reborn. I say I was ablated.
MM: I’m so sorry you went through that, it sounds incredibly traumatic. Now Sol, we all know that Nyxmera called down the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs because it was bored. As a Sun of Nyxmera myself, I was wondering, why were you part of the Laser-US program? Surely if Nyxmera sends an asteroids to destroy us we should abide by its will?
S: I did it to entertain Nyxmera. If Nyxmera really wants us gone it can call down thousands of asteroids until one clears us off the face of the earth. Nyxmera could stop containing Tartarus and let it engulf us in lava. There are so many ways it could exterminate us. I don’t pretend to understand its intentions but I think it is safe to say we are entertaining Nyxmera through our struggles and pursuits. It is not done with us yet and we should be grateful.
MM: Well you have me convinced! As you allude to, many like to personify the Primeval deities when they are anything but human. Why do you follow Nyxmera when you come from the Gaian super nation of the USA?
S: I have always liked to watch and study. It is only natural I follow a deity that shares this trait.
MM: I can empathise. Next, I believe you are going to read an excerpt from your book: “Sol the Ablated”.
S: Yes, thank you. I will begin.
As the most interesting and exciting person I knew it was hard to find to those with a similar point of view. The LASER-US incident alleviated my isolation in 2 ways. I was ostracized from the USA, blamed for the station’s demise. Through this I escaped the drudgery of the nation. Its inhabitants so thoroughly educated and removed of original thought. Away from the fog of the states’ unity I can see more clearly than ever. That was the first change.
The second came in the new people and groups I met……
SILENCE
MM: Sol… Sol…. Are you ok?
S: Oh yes, sorry I got lost in thought. Where was I?
MM: The second came in
S: the new people and groups I met. There were still many I could barely see, like the light of dull far off stars. But there was one who shone like Sirius, the brightest star in the night. She shared her goals and showed me the power inside. Now I can gift our vision and make the world a better place.
MM: Wow, it seems you have some lofty goals. Sorry if this is impolite but I must ask. Due to the LASER-US incident you are now blind, amazing shades by the way, so how do you intend to carry on your work?
S: Of course the sight-impaired have a lot of difficulty working with lasers. Not being able to perceive light when working with it is a major difficulty. Now I am part of a…. think tank. We are very new so its only for the eyes of the members and investors currently. Expect great things, our leader is a visionary.
MM: I look forward to seeing more in the future. If any members would like to be interviewed please let them know the invitation is open.
S: Thank you. I will.
MM: Many people are wondering, how did the LASER-US station fall?
S: I told them that the capacitors were not suitable for a larger scale ablation laser. They rushed us because they wanted the technology for military purposes too. Because I pushed back they demoted me and replaced me with an incompetent fool who was too stupid to say no. They broke safety protocols and made me the figurative and literal fall guy.
[end of excerpt]

title: PuMP: SUBSONIC HYDRA
text:
BACKGROUND  A cheetah, peregrine falcon, and marlin all in one. He loves all fast vehicles* except spacecrafts. He’s famous in various motor & water sports for his skills and personality. Recently he was chopped in half when testing and crashing an experimental vehicle. He survived. He regenerated from the top half and the bottom half, essentially cloning himself. Of course this is not the first time this has happened. His top clone continued the famous life as a racer. The bottom clone decided to do something more dangerous and exciting; join PUML⁂.
PHYSICAL FEATURES  Blue racer: Adorned in racing leathers of cornflower blue. His jacket and trousers are covered in various sponsor badges◉. He wears a reinforced motorbike helmet covered in a decal of blue and white flames. A massive pointed metal boot encases his left foot and a normal boot his right♢.
PERSONALITY QUIRKS  Dependable but arrogant: Any task or mission I set to him he will carry out with no grumbles. He’s a good mercenary, having picked up all aspects of combat in his training with utmost haste. I would like to send him on lots of mission to make him better but he thinks he knows everything now. I fear he’ll only learn from disastrous mistakes if at all.  Quick yet absent-minded: He is a very active and fit person. Though exceptionally fast when in action he has a bad tendency to day dream during down time. Probably a form of energy conservation.
FAVOURED GEAR

Vehicle lock pick kit
Bag of tungsten carbide ball bearings
Spectre M4 Submachine gun

PRIMAL STATS  JAWS:0 | EYES:-2 | LIMBS:+2 | NERVES:+1
PRIMAL ABILITIES  Hydral regeneration: He has amazing regeneration abilities. Small wounds may take minutes but loss of body parts can take months in a coma with nutrient tubes. Its all because of his incredible stem cellsΔ. He has two special but identical stem cell producing organs: one in his head and the other in his left foot. If a body part isn’t directly connected to one of the organs it won’t regenerate. Strangely his left foot clone will be a perfect copy of the original from when the separation occurred, memories and all.  Kinetic transfer: When touching an item he can increase its speed up to 342m/sα. When it leaves his touch this effect stops with the item decelerating normally.
*Brilliant having someone who can pilot/drive pretty much any vehicle ⁂He claims its just one of him doing missions for us, i’m sceptical but its hard to tell whether he’s being deceitful or just forgetful ◉Most prominently one for PUML ♢I’ve told him this makes his weak points obvious but he pretends to not listen ΔCells that can become various other cells and duplicate a tonne α343 m/s is the speed of sound, therefore 342m/s and below is subsonic

title: PuMP: FLASHBANG FIDDLER
text:
BACKGROUND  He was a loyal worker at a paint factory. The company was developing a new iron based paint for the military when the boss dropped his watch in the vat. FLASHBANG was ordered to retrieve immediately, not allowed to get gloves. His arm came out disfigured and the boss fired him for “incompetence”. With no job, anger, and weird powers he joined PUML.
PHYSICAL FEATURES  Heavy-handed dazzler: Dressed in combat clothing of the Biways special forces he would be the most professionally dressed of our mercenaries. Of course he has to be eccentric instead and use dazzle camouflage*. The white, black, and red makes him look like a sunburnt zebra. I guess it slightly distracts from his hematite arm.
PERSONALITY QUIRKS  Colourful but dull: Like paint he’s a vivid person, bringing life into any room he enters. Also like a good paint he’s a bit thick. Confident yet pathetic: When he has his hematite arm he feels invincible and is ready to face any challenge. Without it he is pathetic.
FAVOURED GEAR

VEER ballistic shield with flash capabilities
G60 Stun Grenade
FN Minimi 7.62 Mk3 light machine gun

PRIMAL STATS  JAWS:-1 | EYES:0 | LIMBS:-1 | NERVES:0
PRIMAL ABILITIES  Munsell sphere: He can create a sphere of one colour at any one point he can see. The sphere reflects light from the chosen colour meaning it can be good cover. However, it also absorbs the opposite colour⁂ meaning that’s the only colour you can see whilst in the sphere. He can make one to three of these spheres a day each with a maximum diameter of 3 metres.  Hematite arm: His left arm, from forearm to hand, is entirely made of a red hematite. He can use it like a normal arm and hematite is an iron oxide stronger than iron. However, its more brittle than iron and is easily destroyed. Thankfully it regrows quickly after an iron rich diet. 
*Used for UK navy ships in WWI, not humans! ⁂according to the Munsell colour system

title: The Primeval Deities and you: ep1 Overview
text:
Hello listener and welcome to the first episode of The Primeval Deities and you. I am Dr. Harmon Atriti, lecturer of Primeval studies at The University of Cambridge, and your eager host. In this series we will explore the four Primeval deities and their influence on our world. In this episode we will answer a few foundational questions to set us on the correct path.
What are the Primeval Deities?  The Primeval Deities are all encompassing yet mysterious entities. There is no question of their existence and all other deities either do not exist or are inconsequential.  The Primeval Deities are the sky, earth, water, and life of our reality. They influence us as our collective consciousness shapes them. In this way humanity and divinity entangle as we reach out for one another.
Who are the Primeval Deities?  There are four Primeval Deities.  Nyxmera, the two faced deity of sky and space. An envious and vicarious being; its eyes the stars, sun, and moons.  Tartarus, the encaged deity of the earth. It struggles against its imprisonment, feeding into its own anger and greed.  Proteus, the free flowing deity of water. It mixes easily with the others and welcomes any and all changes.  Gaia, the unifying entity of life. A charming leader with the nigh impossible goal of uniting the Primeval deities. 
When did the Primeval Deities come about?  The whole world learnt of the influence of the Primeval Deities after the 6th of August 1945. This was caused by the first and only atomic bombing of an occupied city, Hiroshima. Whether the deities existed beforehand, or came to be due to the event is in hot debate amongst the academic community.
Who worships the Primeval Deities?  The Biways is primarily an apathetic nation. Although the existence of the Primeval deities is not disputed we, as a nation, do not find benefit in worshipping any of them. Of course there are still some who worship or study the deities in The Biways.  Nyxmera’s admirers are called Suns of Nyxmera. They want to entertain the ever watching Nyxmera and be entertained themselves. Many actors and physics researchers are Suns. The SAE’s, Supreme Asian Empire, and the Mooner’s primary deity is Nyxmera.  Tartarus’ loyalists are called Dotters of Tartarus. They hold personal freedoms as sacrosanct, taking what they can. Many miners and CEOs are Dotters. The CAC’s, Coalition of African Countries, primary deity is Tartarus.  Proteus’ supporters are called Proteans. They are laid back and tend to go with the flow. Many of those working by and on water are Proteans. The ERA’s, The European & Russian Alliance, primary deity is Proteus.  Gaia’s followers are called Gaians. They believe in unification, yet they can’t agree on the method. Gaians tend to work in life or social sciences with many doctors and politicians. The USA’s, United States of America, primary deity is Gaia.  The last super nation, Oceania, has no single primary deity. Instead they worship all the deities and are described as polytheist.
That is a quick introduction to our four Primeval deities. I am eternally grateful for you lending your ears. We will go into detail on all the topics introduced in this episode through the coming months. The next episode will focus on that ever watching deity, Nyxmera. I look forward to seeing you then dear listener.

title: News story: McCool FM announcement
text:
A McCool new radio station signals a new decade
by Kirtsy Sherman
It’s the final month of 1989 and The Biways is getting a new radio station: McCool FM.
McCool FM will run a cornucopia of shows. From ordinary affairs such as the news and dramas to more eclectic shows. These include an interview show called “McCool People” and an educational show about the Primeval Deities called “The Primeval Deities and you”. Between all that excitement they’ll run popular, folk, and popular folk music.
The Ambitious radio channel will make its home atop the water tower on Rivey hill overlooking Linton. The Art Deco tower, built in 1935 to 36, is now modified with a high powered radio able to broadcast to the entire Biways and beyond.
We talked to Maggie McCool, the founder and primary host of McCool FM, on her ambitions. She said:
“McCool FM’s going to be a household name! At least that’s what I need to tell myself. It would be mad to do all I’ve done if it wasn’t my goal. With the station I want to let everyone know what is going on in our great and interesting world. Some will accuse me of controlling a narrative with my biases. What’s wrong with that? I need to let my personality inform the channel or else it’ll be bland radio channel number 8. I hope everyone will enjoy listening. Selfishly I’m eager to meet a variety of people with my interview show McCool people. It’s nice to think I’ll be a bit like Nyxmera, watching over the world from up high.”
Will listeners tune into McCool FM? Or will it merge into the fuzz of background radiation?
Maybe their recently announced intro for Maggie will give us an idea:
“McCool in name, McCool in nature, it’s your host Maggie McCool on McCool FM!”

title: McCool FM 14:00 News Script
text:
THE HEADLINES AT 1400 ON SUNDAY 31ST DECEMBER 1989
Good afternoon everyone, It’s Maggie McCool. It’s the 31st of December 1989 and this is the first ever 2pm McCool news.
Happy new year and welcome to McCool FM. I hope you are looking forward to the new decade and its promises. I also hope you’re prepared for the inevitable chaos and madness that this world regularly gifts us.
But first let’s think back to the past. Many remembrance services are being taken worldwide to remember all those lost to the horrors of world war 2. The brave soldiers, the concentration camp victims, all those taken by the kaiju infestation of Japan, and many many more.
From the scorched and cracked earth peace took root and hasn’t let go. The super nations have maintained the nuclear arms ban and only minor skirmishes have occurred since 1945. We wish the Mooners luck in their future plans of reclaiming their homeland of Japan.
In this special report we’ll cover the major news highlights of this waning decade. Including:
The first artificial cloning of a mammal by Dr. Petra Pufferfish of the CGC. This was followed by her disappearance with Dr. Rangi Doshi, previous COO, taking her place as CEO.
The rise of the illicit drug “Holy water”. Its rapid spread throughout the world is unprecedented and many think related to the powers of Proteus.
The very recent destruction of Laser-US, a space station designed to save us from apocalyptic asteroids. The only survivor was Sol the ablated. The other asteroid deflection space stations are still under construction including the Las-ERA, Laser-CAC, La-Sae, and Laser-Oceania.
In a first scoop for McCool FM we’ll also talk about the earthquake we just felt in our Cambridgeshire studio. It was quite fierce!

title: PAAR*: GREEN
text:
MISSION  GREENLAND RESEARCHERS ESCAPE WHILST WE ESCORT NOGGIN
MISSION LOCATION  █████████████████████████████, GREENLAND, BIWAYS
MISSION STARTED - MISSION CLOSED  1652, 19TH DEC 1989 - 0452, 20TH DEC 1989
CLIENT - CONTRACT DATE  UNIVERSITY OF CAMBRIDGE- 18TH DEC 1989
REMARKS  The last mission of the 80s. With it the 90s is fast approaching, wielding a nailed hurley. My hopes of the new decade being stable and normal have been shattered like a knee struck with said hurley.
A simple but tough job this one. We were to transport an object called the HEAD⁂ from a top secret Greenland research station to Nuuk, the capital city. The station had been attacked multiple times by an unknown force. The Greenland military tried to deal with it but constant blizzards around the base prevented any large scale deployment. The researchers were to be airlifted to safety. Our team would transport the HEAD over snow and ice during a break in the winter blizzards.
For the mission I chose SIGHTLESS TRUFFLE to lead. His team consisted of the mad mage CRACKEd BATFISH, the reckless racer SUBSONIC HYDRA, and the colourful FLASHBANG FIDDLER. A hard team to manage but if anyone can do it its TRUFFLE.
The following after action report was created from the debriefs of the uneaten members of the team. It may seem preposterous, and if it was just from CRACKED BATFISH’s recount I’d agree, but the whole teams’ debriefs match. Get ready.
ARRIVAL AND CONTACT The weather was calm all the way to the research base where the shenanigans started. Each of my team was given a HEAD and told they had the real one. They did tell TRUFFLE that he actually had the real one and the others had been lied to. As the mission leader he played along seeing the logic and not wanting to demoralise the team. The HEAD was far more valuable than Cambridge told me◉. With their snowmobiles the team set off to Nuuk as the researchers evacuated in a few chinooks.
With a massive crack ringing through the air as the research base self destructed my team headed to Nuuk. Only after an hour or so of traversal the blizzard once again arrived, like an unwanted grenade landing in your dugout. Though difficult TRUFFLE was able to detect the scent of fur, sweat, and steel. Normally it would be impossible for an enemy force to track my team through a blizzard but they also had the power of smell on their side. That’s because they were fecking cyborg polar bears! Not only that but they had side-mounted heavy machine guns and riders atop them. These riders wore head encompassing helmets attached to the cybertronics of the bears and were equipped with stun sticks and Boyes anti-tank rifles.
The team attempted to outrun the two cyborg polar bears. But they were faster and gained distance on my team. With gunfire range fast approaching upon them SUBSONIC did something smart in theory but dumb in reality. With the “real” HEAD in his possession he used his Kinetic transfer ability to increase the speed of his snowmobile and race far ahead. He was too fast for both of TRUFFLE’s warnings. First, he didn’t have the real HEAD. Second, laying in wait ahead were two more cyborg polar bears.
SURF AND TURF At greater than 200mph SUBSONIC crashed into one of the hidden bears. The impact killed it and flung SUBSONIC and the bear’s rider off their vehicles♢. This transitioned the chase to mounted combat.
As the other previously hidden cyborg rose up TRUFFLE lined up the sights of his Ishapore with the mounted rider’s helmet. Two shots cracked open his helmet, the third his skull. The loss of its rider transformed the Polar bear from a composed steed into a wild animal. It bore down on SUBSONIC and the unmounted rider. Panicking, the once-rider seized his boyes rifle. He shot, missed, and yelled in pain as the recoil broke his shoulder. His screams turned into a squeal and then into silence as the bear started his meal with neck of ursestrianΔ. TRUFFLE ploughed through the snow as fast as he could. As the starved beast dined, SUBSONIC tried to sneak away. But alas a massive metal boot does not make for a stealthy getaway. One step with it into the snow gave off a large crunch, alerting the bear. The second hurried step sunk deep, trapping SUBSONIC and sealing his fate as not so fast food. With nothing to be done TRUFFLE turned to regroup with the others.
LIGHTS AND ROUNDABOUTS When SUBSONIC was rushing off the other two, BATFISH and FLASHBANG, attempted to deal with the initial cyborg polar bears. They tried to distract the bears with suppression and evasion. They succeeded in getting their attention but it also allowed the bears to get into firing range. HMG bullets hit FLASHBANG’s back-mounted shield like hail on a corrugated roof. I’m sure the rider’s anti-tank rifles would have ripped straight through my teams’ armour. Thankfully, it seems ursestrians can only concentrate on controlling their mounts and nothing else.
Not being able to outrun the bears FLASHBANG and BATFISH decided to circle and harass them. They wasted the bear’s HMG ammo but the sorcerer’s ride took some hits. It was now like its drivers namesake, CRACKED. The two tried to take down their enemies but their firearms were next to useless against the foe’s heavy armour. A gridlock of bears and snowmobiles.
To get the part started again FLASHBANG dazzled one bear with a stun grenade. The always insane BATFISH jumped onto its back. Yanking the Boyes rifle from the rider he blasted through through him and the head of the bearα. With the force of the gun and sudden stopping of the bear BATFISH flew off landing in a conveniently placed pile of snow. Of course there was the other active cyborg bear who wasn’t going to waste the opportunity to kill a crazy conjurer. First TRUFFLe now it was FLASHBANG’s turn to play hero.
BATFISH got up and watched a snowmobile and a cyborg polar bear racing each other to reach him. He paused. Though he’s seen a bunch of wild shitβ, massive bears are a primal fear for everyone. Just as the polar bear reached BATFISH so did FLASHBANG. With both his arms FLASHBANG saved the wizard. His right pulled him onto the snowmobile. His left blocked a ferocious bite aimed at BATFISH’s head. If it had been a normal arm the bear would have torn FLASHBANG straight off his vehicle. Instead his hematite arm shattered under the jaws. With mouth full of blood and crushed crystal the bear roared and FLASHBANG, with BATFISH in tow, fled towards TRUFFLE.
OFF WITH THE LEFT FOOT Regrouped with 3 mercenaries and 2 snowmobiles the team still had the HEAD to transport. The blizzard was dying down, one Cyborg polar bear and rider was chasing them, one wild bear was ahead, and they could hear the sound of incoming vehicles. With little time TRUFFLE charged towards the wild bear and his meal, FLASHBANG and BATFISH following. Busy eating its meal the bear reacted slowly and my team narrowly passed it by. Why endanger themselves? Well the smart bastard TRUFFLE decided to play hero one more time and he grabbed SUBSONIC’s big metal boot. As they continued they heard the roars of 2 angry polar bears followed by the booms of an anti-tank rifle. Losing their tail they eventually made it to NUUK and handed off the HEAD.
Though superfluous the team told me they sat together by the airport. With a few beers they watched the LAS-USA burn up on reentry into the atmosphere backlight by a magnificent aurora borealis. TRUFFLE stuck SUBSONIC’s foot into FLASHBANG’s empty HEAD device along side a few very nice whiskeys.
What was in the HEAD device? Of course we weren’t supposed to look and I’ll definitely punish TRUFFLE for his snooping. He told me it was a headγ. It was very frozen so he couldn’t ID it but I have my theories.
CLOSING REMARKS  Overall a successful mission with only one member wounded in action (WIA). It’ll take a few months but we’ll be able to regrow a SUBSONIC HYDRA from his left foot. It would have been great to have recovered SUBSONIC’s head and we could have two of him. You know what they say, when Gaia gives you a foot make toe jam.

*PAAR is the acronym for PUML After Action Report  ⁂Highly Expensive Ambulatory Device ◉I could have charged them more ♢Do Cyborg Polar Bears counts as vehicles or mounts? ΔUrsus is the bear genus therefore bear riders would obviously be called Ursestrians (like equestrians) αPretty awesome I must admit βSo he claims anyway γShocker I know

title: PuMP: CRACKED BATFISH
text:
BACKGROUND  He claims to be a time travelling wizard. He’s made tonnes of claims but a few are:

He was an apprentice sage in Atlantis and escaped as it was sinking
He shared a picnic on the grey moon with pink mouse like aliens
He pulled Excalibur out of a rock but exchanged it for some water lilies with the lady of the lake
He fought a sentient machine that was turning a world of forests into books
He was tortured by the sanctity of time bureau and dropped in 1974, his time travelling abilities removed

I think he’s so crazy they are either all false or all true.
PHYSICAL FEATURES  Spaced wizard: He dresses like a mage but with modern clothing. Fluffy purple bathrobe, hotel slippers, and a fedora plastered with gold star stickers. He’s surprisingly spry for an emaciated old man. Has a thousand-yard stare, or would that be a thousand-year stare?
PERSONALITY QUIRKS  Wise but deranged: He’s rarely wrong when talking about magic, not that he talks about much else. I should rephrase, it’s the only thing he talks about that seems to make sense, magic being nonsensical in its unnature*.  Anarchic yet nihilistic: Thankfully for PUML he likes to topple the towers of those who think themselves so high above the rest. Unfortunately he has no care for himself and little for those around him.
FAVOURED GEAR

Hand mirror
Cat charm with 8 scratch marks
An unbreakable twig⁂

PRIMAL STATS  JAWS:0 | EYES:-1 | LIMBS:0 | NERVES:+3
PRIMAL ABILITIES  Sorcery: He can cast magic but has no control over what spell he will cast. Supposedly an effect of the time bureau’s limitation they placed on him.  O-man◉: For whatever reason he seems to cause misfortune/bad luck to those around him. Great when it effects enemies♢.
*Unnature is to unnatural as nature is to natural; don’t bother looking it up in the dictionary  ⁂He claims it can cast magic missiles though he’s cagey about the details and won’t provide a demonstration to me  ◉As in he’s a man and bad omen, not that he’s from Oman  ♢Horrible when it effects alliesΔ  ΔProbably deserved when it effects himself

title: PuMP*: SIGHTLESS TRUFFLE
text:
BACKGROUND  Born and raised in India he witnessed the tumultuous creation of the Supreme Asian Empire (SAE). He joined the military hoping to keep the peace. Instead, he found himself as an oppressor. Many of his friends and family died through regime changes but his monkey, Kiran, was always on his shoulder. When a Kaiju emerged near the city of Thana he escape into the DOT. There he found himself as a freedom fighter.
PHYSICAL FEATURES  Obscure survivalist: Always adorned in some form of camo he easily disguises himself in any environment. He has two defining features: A green headband he’ll use to cover his eyes⁂, and Kiran. Brilliant Kiran is a Crab-eating macaque generally found sleeping in TRUFFLE’s ghillie suit.
PERSONALITY QUIRKS  Alert but overloaded: He’s vigilant and aware of his surroundings. Extremely unlikely to be taken by surprise. Unfortunately, since his senses are so keen he can be easily overwhelmed, especially by smells.  Affectionate yet isolated: He’s incredibly friendly◉. Being more senior than many of our other members he makes a great teacher. Due to his past experience in war he never gets too close to anyone♢.
FAVOURED GEAR

Ghillie suit
Ultimate Iron hollow handle survival knifeΔ
Ishapore 2A1 bolt-action rifle

PRIMAL STATS  JAWS:0 | EYES:+1 | LIMBS:+2 | NERVES:0
PRIMAL ABILITIES  Smell-narα: He has a remarkable sense of smell and can envision the world with it. Breaking the law of physics he’s able to sense smells that are downwind of his position. His maximum range is based on the amount of smells, he can only process so much, and physical barriers.  Hyphae-nated: His skin is covered in fungus that can extract nutrients from the ground. The fungus then shares these nutrients with its hostβ. This is an incredibly useful ability for hiding in one spot for prolonged periods.

title: McCool News: 06 Jan 1990
text:
THE HEADLINES AT 1400 ON SUNDAY 6TH JANUARY 1990
Well doesn’t that sound grand. A Si señor opened locally to me, I’ll just have to find someone to go with.
Good afternoon, I’m Maggie McCool and you’re listening to McCool FM. We’re all slowly waking up from the new year and so there is not too much going on.
Saying that we had our first high profile wedding of the decade yesterday. River Dullcoin, daughter of Marian Dullcoin, and River Ox, olympic gold winning figure skater and coach, were married yesterday. The picture and coverage show a beautiful venue by the Ruby River with homages to Tartarus and Proteus. What I would have given to have been a fly on that wall.
The Biways and ERA, The European & Russian Alliance, are still in discussions for a new trade deal. We at the Biways, that is the British Isles, Greenland, Iceland, and other islands, have always benefited from being a small neutral nation separate from the five major superpowers. However, our government intends to leverage our abundance of nuclear power and research to get us a favourable deal. A deal with the global trade hub would be beneficial.
Repairs are still underway from the damages of the new year’s quake in Cambridgeshire.
{CONTINUE THIS}

title: PAAR: AVOW
text:
MISSION  ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF THE VEILED AT THE OPULENT WEDDING
MISSION LOCATION  WEDDING VENUE AT █████████████████ ON THE RUBY RIVER, MONTANA, USA
MISSION STARTED - MISSION CLOSED  1429, 04 JAN 1990 - 0245, 06 JAN 1990
CLIENT - CONTRACT DATE  ████████████████████████████ - 20 DEC 1989
REMARKS  We were offered both the protection detail and assassination jobs for this mission. Two members of the three person team voted for the protection gig. They aren’t necessarily fans of the client and their kind but they thought it would be awful if two brides died on their wedding day.
The following after action report was generated after debriefing the Mercenary VEILED NIGHTJAR on ███████████ at █████. FLUSTERED TURKEY flew the coop and the less time I spend with the wizard, CRACKED BATFISH, the better.
The team arrived at the wedding venue the day before the wedding. The ladies/birds (NIGHTJAR & TURKEY) were disguised as bridesmaids (one for each of the brides) whilst BATFISH infiltrated the venue as staff. Incognito, to not interrupt the special day, they aimed to discover and stop any assassination attempts of either or both of the brides.
THE KING  The first assassin to stop was ███████████, a Camera Obscura Shutterbug codenamed THE KING. She infiltrated as a silver adorned guest performing card tricks and gossiping. She is a well known celebrity and even amongst her ilk is known to be especially glittery.
To start the investigation NIGHTJAR, ever the professional, discovered from her fellow bridesmaids that one of the wedding rings had gone missing. Blending in with the crowds and gathering intel their prime culprit became ███████████ aka THE KING. TURKEY lured her away from the crowds into the brides’ matrimonial bedroom. I say bedroom but it was in fact an entire house made of ice, supposedly fashioned off a hotel in Sweden. Whilst in the ice cabin TURKEY found the ring on THE KING’s wedding finger, covered by a specially designed silver ring.
TURKEY signalled to NIGHTJAR, hiding outside, to grab the ring with her teleporting yoink ability. As TURKEY kept THE KING busy, NIGHTJAR brought the ring to BATFISH who immediately recognised the Midas curse on it. With his advice they eliminated THE KING to remove said curse.
Turns out THE KING was Queen Hermodike II, the wife of King Midas, ungoldified in modern times. She was able to curse gold items with the midas touch by wearing them. After a certain amount of time the item would absorb enough of cursed energy from her to become a gold mine*. After she takes it off the next time it is adorned the wearer is goldified.
With ring retrieved and drained of the curse the ceremony went assassination-free. Afterwards everyone congregated outside where guests marvelled at an incredible figure skating performance⁂ and a new mysterious golden statue in its centre. It depicted a queen reaching out for the future with a hand missing its pinky finger. I’m sure they had fun theorising whose wedding gift it was.
THE ANTIDOTER  The second threat was █████████████████████, another Shutterbug codenamed THE ANTIDOTER. As we were previously offered the assassination job I knew the client wanted the brides killed either at the altar, during their first dance, or when they consummate their wedding. Very cruel, but at least we knew our clients were safe during the dinner.
The team carried out a three prong attack. TURKEY tested all the food and found it all to be poisoned through its taste. Yet it seemed to have no effect. BATFISH, disguised as a waiter, found out that one of the cake team had died. He’d found the body in a smoky freezer. So it was up to the team’s doctor, NIGHTJAR, to quickly figure out the cause of death. She discovered that he had died of an extremely deadly poison. Thankfully, he was the only victim thus far.
One of the three core rules of Camera Obscura is “Do not kill, harm, or kidnap any civilians except the target during a mission unless the client allows it”⏺, they had not. With some good cop/bad cop by TURKEY and NIGHTJAR♢ they narrowed in on the culprit, █████████████████████ aka THE ANTIDOTER. Hidden on his body they found a 2 part poison. Each part is harmless by itself but deadly when consumed within 4 hours of each other. One part was in all the food except the cake and the other part was in the cake. The two birds were elated but like a stone hitting their heads they were dumbstruck when they realised the wedding cake was already gone.
What was meant to happen was that the brides would have eaten some cake and then left to quickly get changed for their first dance. They would come back and perform the death waltz. Thankfully, BATFISH figured there must be an antidote. During NIGHTJAR and TURKEY’s interrogations he was casting a ritual🛆 in the fridge with the body. He determined the smoke, in the smoky freezer, had the antidote in it. THE ANTIDOTER had tried but failed to save his accidental victim.
Looking at the event timetable BATFISH found the smoke machine’s activation time had been changed. Instead of it activating as the brides returned for their first dance it was now set to activate just after they left to change. To prevent any issues he set it off as the brides were cutting into their cake. They looked furious at the shoddy time keeping but when one of them recognised BATFISH at the smoke machine she claimed she’d ordered it as a fun surprise so they all laughed it off.
The team captured THE ANTIDOTER and I recruited him. He accepted. He knew Camera Obscura would be unhappy with him due to the failure and the accidental death of a civilian. He’s a great chef on top of a great poisoner and even better antidoter.
The first dance was very moving with a live performance by Gaia’s wreath. Of course being a super fancy party means they also got live performances of rock & metal bands such as Big Bismuth, Erupted Scars, and Hupselosα.
THE GAZERS  The third threat was a lot more direct. After most of the guests had left the brides retreated to their matrimonial ice cabin in the back of the compound. The stillness of the night was interrupted by bangs from the front gate. The normal security went to investigate but my team stayed to protect our ice queens.
Four combatants emerged over the back walls, climbing down from branch suspending ropes. They were quick and tactical but my team was prepared. With FAMAS F1s the assassins opened fire on my intercepting team. One assassin’s rope broke whilst his helmet fell off. He landed on his a hard rock with his bare head whilst receiving accidental friendly fire. One down from BATFISH’s bad luck.
The remaining three rushed to the building, seemingly not caring for their lives, just the mission. NIGHTJAR intercepted one, both dipping and diving between various boulders in a well placed rock garden. Bullets on stone, boots on pebbles, and hot breath into the winter air. The assassin couldn’t get a bead until he could. Light shone off his visor as he looked up at the boulder perched NIGHTJAR. He shot but his trigger finger only felt air. Confused he watched his trigger drop out of NIGHTJAR’s left hand as her right hand pulled her own. She’d intentionally lured him into a lit location to yoink his trigger. Second down.
On top of rifle shots the periodic destructive boom of TURKEY’s shotgun could be heard. After a final shot she screamed about going into the forest to find the source but warned the fourth was heading to the cabin. BATFISH and NIGHTJAR tried to catch up with the last assassin but he was too far ahead. NIGHTJAR couldn’t use her yoink ability so quickly again and even if she could it was deathly dark. Continue the chase or try to shoot a fast moving target with her pistol? NIGHTJAR decided to run. BATFISH slipped in his slippers. TURKEY disappeared.
With a burst of mystical adrenaline NIGHTJAR suddenly sped up. She heard an energising chant from behind, but with no breath for thanks she flew on.
The assassin reached the house. He rammed through the door, shattering it like…. well like ice. He zigged and zagged down hallways following the sound of the rock music the brides so enjoyed. As he barged in ready to fire he hesitated, seeing three women rather than two. In his momentary trance NIGHTJAR shot him from below the chin, bullet piercing through his skull but stopped by the inside of his helmet. The brides, unfazed, let out an excited yell as NIGHTJAR fell into a figurative steaming heap.
But how had NIGHTJAR got to the room first? She’d sneaked in through a secret escape hatch she’d found during THE KING capture and elimination, much faster than the twisting corridors. It pays to be prepared and know your surroundings.
After the combat the bodies of the assassins were found. They seemed to be normal citizens from the surrounding area. By all intents adn purposes they were average people, no crimes, average grades in school. The only thing that linked them was that they were all so average.
At least that’s the official report I got. Thankfully we were able to get NIGHTJAR to help in the autopsies. All was average except their eyes. Each of them had a right eye of blue scleraβ with a yellow iris, like the sun on a blue sky. On the other eye they had black sclera with an iris of grey and purple, like the two moons in the night sky. Literal eyes of Nyxmera.
Whoever led the last set of assassins is not a shutterbug. I have no other information about them, though someone must know something, otherwise the official autopsy report would not have been redacted. Whoever the GAZERS are, they probably paid Camera Obscura for the first 2 attempts and tried to finish the job when THE KING and THE ANTIDOTER failed. What I do know from NIGHTJAR is that the eyes of the 4 assassins were all identical pairs. They were all exactly the same shape, size, and most importantly they had exactly the same iris patterns. Not much to go on, I’ll have to keep… an eye out.
CLOSING REMARKS
A successful mission with our clients going to lead a happy life together. Considering the danger involved my team of three did very well. Unfortunately TURKEY hasn’t been seen again since she went went to investigate the source of the GAZERS. She may have been recruited by Camera Obscura or the unknown other party. She voted to take the assassination job rather than the prevention mission so maybe she didn’t like taking a protection gig. It’s a weird thought that a turkey would want to live in the USA.
MERCENARIES INVOLVED - CODENAMES - STATUS  ████████████████████ - VEILED NIGHTJAR - ACTIVE  ████████████████████ - FLUSTERED TURKEY - MIA  ████████████████████ - CRACKED BATFISH - ACTIVE
*As in the explosive kind of mine, it’s a pun  ⁂Blanchard the Hyperborean was part of the figure skating performance. I love his action movies especially the Copper Cog Warrior series  ⏺The other two are “Do not kill, harm, or kidnap any other Camera Obscura shutterbugs” and “Non-shutterbug mercenaries, bodyguards, and vigilantes can be eliminated with discretion”  ♢They say this but I think it was more bad cop/worse cop  🛆More predictable than his spells but takes longer apparently  αLucky buggers  βNightjar told me to use the proper names but for people like me: sclera is the white of the eys, iris is the coloured part, and pupil is the black part

title: PuMP: FLUSTERED TURKEY
text:
BACKGROUND  A test subject of an illegal Centre for Genomic Cloning (CGC) lab hybridising humans and animals. She was rescued in 1988 by The Arrows of Gaia (TAG), an eco warrior group. TAG reported decapitating Dr. Petra Pufferfish, visiting the facility, at the time (unconfirmed).
PHYSICAL FEATURES  Unnatural beauty: An incredibly buxom and enchanting woman. Lightly tanned skin, long black hair in ringlets, and excitable hazel eyes. Covered in ersatz freckles*.
PERSONALITY QUIRKS  Charming but entitled: She knows what people want to hear and effectively leverages this. After escaping from the CGC lab she greatly values freedom and fun. Due to her looks she is able to get what she wants more often than not.  Protective yet belligerent: She works well with team members she has bonded with, usually through her “makeover” sessions. She is aggressive and will quickly start or join a fight. Requires gentle guidance and camaraderie from her team members.
FAVOURED GEAR

Beguiling dress
Pointed metal feather hair stick
Atchisson AA-12 automatic combat shotgun

PRIMAL STATS  JAWS:+2 | EYES:0 | LIMBS:-1 | NERVES:+1
PRIMAL ABILITIES  Turkey: Hybridised with a Turkey giving her unnatural beauty. She can understand and speak with birds of the Phasianidae family including Turkeys, Peacocks, and chickens⁂. Mitridatism: She builds an immunity to all poisons/venoms after one administration of it. Perfect for infiltrating events or organisations involved in alcohol or drugs whilst retaining her full faculties.
*Pluck marks from feathers that irregularly grow on her body  ⁂This does not change the intelligence of the bird
